heading: Designation of a chief technology officer within certain elements of the intelligence community

tree.heading: Designation authority
tree.text: The head of each covered element of the intelligence community shall designate a senior official to serve as the chief technology officer of such element.

tree.heading: Covered elements
tree.text: For purposes of this section, the covered elements of the intelligence community are the following:

tree.heading: Responsibility
tree.text: The chief technology officer of each covered element of the intelligence community shall be responsible for assisting the head of such element in the identification and adoption of technology to advance mission needs.

tree.heading: Prohibition of dual appointment
tree.text: Any chief technology officer designated pursuant to subsection (a) may not concurrently serve as the chief information officer, the chief data officer, or the principal science officer of any element of the intelligence community.

notes.heading: Definitions
notes.text: For definition of “intelligence community” as used in this section, see section 7002 of Pub. L. 118–31, set out as a note under section 3003 of this title.
